A '''small secret base''' was established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Randa/Legends|Randa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Randa_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] near the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on [[Randa/Legends|Randa]]]]
This [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base contained at least two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]].<ref name="TSKR" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] traveled to this base to check on [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Shortly after their landing, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] discovered [[Mira Volz]] hiding aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="TSKR" />

Sometime later, the base was [[Battle of Randa|decimated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a reward for this success, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] would eventually be given command of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="Despoilers3">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>
